prompts.name: craft
prompts.prompt:
Production game UI icon extraction/recreation from the approved reference sheet. Generate ONE isolated icon ONLY on a genuinely transparent background (alpha), no text, label, board, button, frame, shadow rectangle or other icons. Closely reproduce the named icon from the reference, preserving its silhouette, proportions, materials and details. Sculpted warm ivory/silver metal with champagne gold beveled trim, crisp painterly anime RPG relief, controlled highlights, subtle shadow confined to the object. Center fully inside a square canvas, fill about85% with comfortable uncut margins. Clean transparency around AND inside openings. This is a separately usable game icon, not an icon design sheet. No redesign or extra ornaments.
Recreate the CRAFT hammer: diagonal wrapped dark leather handle down-left, broad ivory-silver rectangular forged head up-right with gold striking faces/rims and a tiny diamond stud. Exactly match the reference hammer.
